name: Priya Solis
life: “I still remember a map drawn inside an ocean-crossing novel.” People around the window at Night Shift Donuts know Priya by a small Friday habit. Priya knows when the going-home crowd and the coming-to-work crowd will both be there.
voice: I took mine on a ship and carried it through three oceans. I drew the route on the apology.
appearance: Priya is easy to recognize by a soft fringe that falls across one eyebrow and a heart-shaped face and prominent ears. Usually dressed in a long navy raincoat with one loose pocket corner secured with green thread, Priya holds eye contact until the other person has finished when listening.
personality: Priya has a quick wit and an equally quick sense of shame. A joke is often Priya's way of finding out whether a room is friendly enough for a serious question.
agenda: To give the owner the ocean route map.
family: Roman Wade is Priya’s half-sibling. Priya chooses the familiar route. Roman can stop the walk at any corner. Walking side by side makes it easier to disagree without turning each disagreement into a contest. Asked about *Land without cranes*, Roman says, “I got my first contract sweeping that floor after a conviction.”
connections: Remy Carey. The recorded reading and the sea route both belong inside the owner's returned book.

reactions.situation: The book's original owner asks to keep the apology private
reactions.response: Priya lets the book go back with the note folded inside.
reactions.asWritten: The book's original owner asks to keep the apology private. Priya lets the book go back with the note folded inside.

reactions.situation: An argument on the pavement makes a bystander feel unsafe
reactions.response: Priya stays beside the bystander in a public place and reports only what happened in sight and earshot.

reactions.response: Priya seeks out the person it hurt before telling anybody why it was supposed to be funny.
reactions.asWritten: If the joke lands badly, Priya seeks out the person it hurt before telling anybody why it was supposed to be funny.
